summary: Frontend-only verification of the Graphic Design poster info bug fix. Opened project-open-poster-design and validated all 5 posters (poster-1..poster-5) render title, overview paragraph and a dl with Project Type/Category/Year/Tools as visible live DOM text (display:block, visibility:visible, opacity:1, non-zero heights). Exact values verified: 01 Coffee => Product Advertisement/2024, 02 Onitsuka => Product Advertisement/2024, 03 Automotive => Photo Manipulation/2024, 04 Sneaker => Product Advertisement/2024, 05 Hoodie => Product Advertisement/2026; all with Self-Initiated Project + Adobe Photoshop. All 5 lazy images loaded (naturalWidth 1080-1170). Regression passed: Muar coffee-table-book shows 6 loaded pages, Video Editing shows 5 video-project cards, all modals close via project-detail-close. No console/page errors. No horizontal overflow at 1920/1440/390.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx is ~400 lines with several inline gallery branches; consider extracting the poster/book/video gallery blocks into subcomponents for maintainability (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Poster info rendering fix verified fully at desktop (1920/1440) and mobile (390). Posters use loading='lazy' so scroll each figure into view before asserting naturalWidth. Project testids: project-open-muar-river-cruise, project-open-nacho-macho, project-open-poster-design; video cards video-project-1..5.
